VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 64 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The only evidence provided is a self-report (SELF class provenance), which is unverified and unsubstantiated. Without CI logs, test output, diffs, or any independent artifact demonstrating that the tests actually pass, the acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed as satisfied. A self-report alone is insufficient to verify objective test results.
